prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One complete high-fidelity desktop web application screen, flat front-facing landscape 1536x1024, not a device mockup or photograph. Reference image is the USER-APPROVED PDV composition C. Inherit precisely its established identity and component character: modest white navigation, sober blue #0369a1 primary, #f8fafc page ground, white content surfaces, dark #0f172a text, Segoe UI/Inter-like readable sans-serif, MUI-like labelled controls, gently rounded corners and quiet separators. The reference contributes palette, typography, navigation character and density, NOT its products, checkout bar or cart topology. This is an operational app used by keyboard/mouse, not marketing: no hero, graphs, giant KPI cards, decorative photos, gradients, neon, oversized avatars, fake capabilities, tooltips floating over text, developer controls. Compact useful hierarchy; normal readable Portuguese; clear one primary action per active context. Complete page uncropped within image. All demonstration data are synthetic; discreet visible note 'Dados fictícios · Proposta visual'. Left sidebar 190px with brand Lojas Manu and all eight menu items Dashboard, PDV, Pedidos, Clientes, Produtos, Saídas Financeiras, Relatórios, Configurações, selecting current route in blue. Bottom sidebar user Operador / operador@example.invalid / Sair. Thin main header, no duplicated oversized route titles. Icons consistent and small, generous hit areas, secondary actions quiet. Core UI text remains real readable words in the mockup. Never imply direct status change by dragging, unapproved credit, stock, marketing communications, or real customer facts.CONTENT: route Clientes. Header title Clientes, primary + Novo cliente. Compact search 'Buscar nome, CPF ou telefone' and Situação: Todos; optional compact counters 8 clientes / 7 ativos / 1 inativo without big cards. Eight synthetic customers: Cliente de demonstração (active,3 pedidos,R$319,30 compras finalizadas); Marina Exemplo (active,1,R$159,90); Bruno Exemplo (active,2,R$249,00); Carla Exemplo (inactive,1,R$0,00); Daniel Exemplo (active,1,R$120,00); Elisa Exemplo (active,1,R$79,90); Fábio Exemplo (active,2,R$199,00); Gabriela Exemplo (active,1,R$59,90). All have fictional phone (00) 00000-0000; show readable names with contact underneath, dark aligned money text, dark readable textual Ativo/Inativo chips on pale neutral/green background. Do not overwhelm with blue avatars on every row. List actions Abrir ficha and quiet menu; keep destructive actions inside menu, not primary. Table footer 1–8 de 8 / 25 por página. Selected Cliente de demonstração full profile: Ativo, phone (00) 00000-0000, email cliente@example.invalid, CPF não informado. Contact, Endereços and Histórico grouped cleanly. Two full active structured addresses: Principal / Rua Exemplo, 123 · Centro / Fortaleza – CE · CEP 00000-000; secondary Endereço 2 / Avenida Modelo, 45 · Bairro Exemplo / Fortaleza – CE · CEP 00000-000. Clear indication 'Principal' only on the first address; secondary 'Editar endereços'. Brief 'Pedidos anteriores mantêm o endereço registrado.' Profile has 3 pedidos and Compras finalizadas R$319,30, and recent history #1048 01/10/2026 Pendente R$319,30; #1038 28/09/2026 Finalizado R$249,00; #1030 25/09/2026 Finalizado R$70,30. Pending value does not count toward finalized purchases. Primary contextual + Nova venda (opens PDV with selected client preserving any existing draft through confirmation), secondary Editar cliente, quiet Mais ações. No credit, loyalty, financial risk score, WhatsApp send buttons, social links, invented consent or customer photograph.
COMPOSITION CLIENTES C — FICHA EM JANELA: Full-width compact table of clients behind a centered conventional white profile modal about 850px wide and 680px high. Background header and search visible, eight client rows indicated, selected first row pale blue; light neutral modal backdrop. Foreground title Cliente de demonstração / Ativo / close, contact phone/email/CPF in compact row. Below two balanced columns: Endereços left with two complete addresses and Principal only on first, Histórico right with three readable rows and summary 3 pedidos / Compras finalizadas R$319,30. Quiet Editar endereços within addresses. Fixed modal footer single primary + Nova venda, secondary Editar cliente, quiet Fechar. No lateral panel, no inline expansion, no giant avatar. All complete addresses and footer actions fully visible inside screen. Preserve global list context behind dialog.
Header constraint: do not copy 'Rascunho local' from the PDV reference: this screen consults saved records, it has no active sale draft indicator. Do not add a keyboard shortcuts toolbar inherited from PDV. Header carries route title and synthetic-data note only.
